name: coalossal
flavor: While it’s engaged in battle, its mountain of coal will burn bright red, sending off sparks that scorch the surrounding area.

abilities.name: steam-engine
abilities.effect: Boosts the Speed stat drastically when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire- or Water-type move.

abilities.name: flame-body
abilities.effect: Has a 30% chance of burning attacking Pokémon on contact.

abilities.name: flash-fire
abilities.effect: Protects against Fire moves.  Once one has been blocked, the Pokémon's own Fire moves inflict 1.5× damage until it leaves battle.
